listen.law: SOURCE → ADDRESS → APERTURE → PROJECTION → ANNOTATION → RETURN

research_signal.conclusion: RSVP remains a bounded throughput/attention mode with cheap regression/review, not a universal replacement for ordinary reading.

deep_conclusions: READFIELD is an addressed attention/work transform, not primarily a speed-reader.
Phone work should be serial: HELD OBJECT → JOB → 1–3 OPERATIONS → VISIBLE CONSEQUENCE → WITNESS → RETURN.
A mechanism that cannot currently produce consequence must expose the missing condition instead of appearing inert.
SPEED → friction → READ → resolve → SPEED is the primary RSVP loop; regression is a comprehension mechanism, not an exception.
Marks are addressed re-entry evidence, not a new note-taking authority.
VOICE is a projection of the same text cursor; LISTEN remains the sibling audio host.
Borrowed clock != borrowed authorship remains the cross-surface law.
Cross-app integration should appear as verbs/recipes, not integration settings.
One visible control authority is preferable to the prior header + work-rail + aperture-control competition; legacy controls remain implementation seams, not parallel user authority.
